name: Made Men

tenures.source: the fed's own served Rankings page, naming the Made Men BSWF Tag Team Champions; the fed's own served Thursday Night Thump-Fest broadcast, where the pair defend the belts against Kadafi and Scarface, joined at ringside by the (unnamed) Made Men Body Guards

caption: Merchandi$e and Mi$ta's own tag team, the BSWF's own last-attested Tag Team Champions — how or when they won the belts is not recorded.
